# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** housewife  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

She has work-hardened hands and kind old arms.

_Sources: [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001), [v3 c40 P14](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0014)_

## Personality

Rachel Lynde is a capable, practical, and hardworking woman who prides herself on speaking her mind without fear or favor. Highly opinionated, critical, and curious, she loves to keep a sharp eye on community business and dearly loves to be asked for advice. Despite being a meddlesome gossip who can be compulsively corrective and strict, she is fundamentally a good, kind-hearted Christian woman. She is a passionate, red-hot politician, yet remains a tender and devoted nurse to her sick husband.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P1](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0001), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c18 P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v3 c13 P7](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0007)_

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde lived in Lynde's Hollow on the main road in Avonlea, where she kept a sharp eye on all community happenings while keeping house and running local societies. When Marilla Cuthbert adopted Anne Shirley, Rachel criticized the child's looks, prompting an angry outburst from Anne; Rachel later acknowledged her error as Anne matured. When her husband Thomas fell gravely ill, Rachel nursed him untiringly until his death. Facing financial difficulties after his passing due to an earlier farm mortgage, she accepted Marilla's invitation to move to Green Gables to live together, freeing Anne to attend college. Later, she traveled from Avonlea to Four Winds to spend Christmas with Anne and Gilbert.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c30 P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000), [v4 c15 P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001)_
